name: SCU Vice Chancellor's Scholarship
summary: $50,000 offered automatically to the top 10 school leavers with an ATAR of 95 or more starting full-time at SCU.
who: Starting a full-time bachelor degree at SCU in 2027.
how: No application. Students do not have to apply for merit-based scholarships.
catches: Offered to the top 10 eligible students.
Can't be combined with another merit-based scholarship.

source.label: Southern Cross University: Vice Chancellor's Scholarship

evidence.quote: Have achieved an ATAR of 95 or above.
Offers will be made to the top 10 highest achieving eligible students with an ATAR 95 or above.
